metadata.name: Uno-Class Ultrasonic Ranger and OLED Result

components.value: Program Ultrasonic ranger; Trigger D9; Echo D8; Display I2C
Echo 5882 us; Minimum 20 mm; Maximum 4000 mm

nonPhysicalItems.reason: Shared return net for the board and supply.

physicalNotes: Install U1 with pin 1 at F10 and program the 8 MHz internal oscillator without division.
Cable J2 to the US-100 VCC, TRIG/TX, ECHO/RX and either GND pin. Remove the US-100 jumper. Cable J3 by signal labels to the 5 V Adafruit 4440 OLED breakout.

nonPhysicalItems.reason: External stimulus or supply connects through J1.
Shared return net for the board and supply.

pcbFabrication.fabricationNotes: J1 supplies 5 V. J2 connects the US-100 in trigger/echo mode. J3 connects the Adafruit 4440 OLED. Program U1 for the internal 8 MHz oscillator without division.
